_comment: Demo ad catalogue for Hangman (same placements as Pac-Man). 'continue' plays on Game Over's Watch Ad & Continue (+2 guesses, once per attempt). 'restart' plays on the in-game Restart button (once per attempt). 'level_gate' plays after Congratulations, when the player presses Next Level, on every 3rd level (3, 6, 9 ...). 'recover' plays 5 times in a row on Level Select when the player taps a level the 24-hour reset took back (a level they'd reached before); it is 30 seconds with a skip button appearing after 10, same non-skippable window as 'continue' and 'restart' — skipping (or finishing) one advances straight to the next of the 5. 'level_complete_banner' is a compact horizontal image card shown INSIDE the Congratulations popup, below the coins-earned line. All creatives are bundled LOCALLY so they never depend on reaching an outside domain - swap in your own files any time, same names or update streamUrl. 'banner' is the IAB VERTICAL_BANNER 300x600 (half-page / skyscraper) shown in the space either side of the board during play; those cards are rendered at that exact size and scaled as a whole when the window is smaller, so the 1:2 shape never changes. 'leaderboard' is the IAB LEADER_BOARD 970x90, shown as a single wide banner ABOVE the board on windows with no side gutter for the 300x600 cards (portrait tablets, phones, narrow windows) - same scale-as-a-whole rule, so the 970:90 shape never changes either. Every image placement here now rotates: wherever a placement holds more than one ad, the card on screen swaps to the next one every 5 seconds rather than sitting on a single creative - that applies to 'leaderboard', to 'banner' (the 300x600 cards beside the maze) and to 'level_complete_banner' (the 300x250 inside the Congratulations popup). Adding another ad to any of those placements below extends that placement's rotation with no code change. The 'level_complete_banner', 'banner', and 'leaderboard' placements each now each carry THREE Credit Key image creatives, so the 5-second rotation visibly cycles 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 1. The two extra creatives per placement are stand-in Credit Key layouts built only from claims already in the original ads; replace the files (same names) or edit the entries to use real ones.
